text:
marta: Morning async check-in — cut window in ~3h (13:00 UTC). Canary is on v2.4.1-canary, we have 5 cherry-picks pending. Post 1-liners: what you did / blockers / today. Please ping owners for approvals :rocket:

alex: Did backport for #4217 (storage ttl fix). CI is red on integration tests. Investigating flaky `kv_compaction_test`.

ci-bot: CI failure — PR #4217 — integration/linux — failed at 00:03:12. Log: https://ci.internal/4227/logs (artifact: test-fail.log)

alex: Thanks @ci-bot. Re-running job now: `ci run --pr 4217 --scope integration`

sam: Merged #4220 (canary perf tweak) into train. Watching canary metrics (latency p95 down ~8%). No blockers from my side. Will monitor for next 30m. :eyes:

dina: Took ownership of backport #4219 (metrics labeling). Will raise PR this morning and request doc updates. No blockers.

release-bot: Canary deploy started at 2024-06-18T10:30:45Z — tag: v2.4.1-canary. Canary subset: 3/20 nodes.

alex: Re-run finished — still failing the same test. Attaching failing snippet:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVCompaction (0.12s)
    kv_test.go:213: expected 3 segments, got 4
```
I suspect a race in test fixture. Will add extra waits and resubmit.

marta: Good call. Prioritize stability over last-minute cherrypicks. If #4217 can't be stabilized within the cut window, we'll defer it to the next train. Can the owners give quick +1s on the remaining picks?

sam: +1 on #4220 (already merged).

dina: I'll request reviewers for #4219 once I open it.

alex: If I can't stabilize #4217 in 45m, I'll create a revert-ready PR and we can opt to skip. Noted.

marta: Thanks — can folks also confirm if any manual DB migrations are included in any of the picks? I don't see any, but double-check please.

sam: No migrations in #4220.

dina: #4219 is only metrics labels, no migrations.

release-bot: Cut window reminder in 90m. (automated)

marta: Okay — plan: monitor canary for 1h, freeze new cherrypicks unless critical. If anything blocks the release channel us here and ping me directly. :phone:

alex: Will update here after the next CI run.

ci-bot: CI update — PR #4217 re-run queued (job id 76543).
